name: Data.exists_common_hecke_rallis
summary: The pairs (a Phi_V(p_V), a' Phi_V'(p_V')), p in heckeAlgebra(D), form a finite-dimensional, hence closed, subspace; (B, B') is the sum of the series of pairs of terms, so it suffices that each pair of terms lies there. For a coset i with representative r, the Hecke element (scalar) sum over q in chosenLevel/H of [q r q^(-1)], H the elements of chosenLevel conjugated by r into chosenLevel, is trivial at the chosen places, preserves principal forms, and has <z, p y> = [chosenLevel : H] <z, R(r) y>, which with the scalar of rallisTerm gives the term, for V and V' alike.

steps.claim: For a space V let Phi_V be the linear map from End(principalForms(D, V)) to functions on pairs, T -> ((z, y) -> <z, T y>).
steps.lean: let Φ {s} V : End ℂ (@D.principalForms _ s V) →ₗ[ℂ] _ := .pi fun z ↦ .pi (innerₛₗ ℂ z ∘ₗ applyₗ ·)

steps.claim: Read h and h' as convergence of series of functions on pairs: sum_g a rallisTerm(D, theta, j, V, ., ., g) = B and sum_g a' rallisTerm(D, theta, j, V', ., ., g) = B'.

The pair (B, B') is the sum of the series of pairs of terms. The pairs (a Phi_V(p_V), a' Phi_V'(p_V')), p in heckeAlgebra(D), form the image of a linear map from heckeAlgebra(D) into a finite-dimensional space, hence a closed subspace; so (B, B') lies in it, which gives p with the two formulas, as soon as the pair of terms of every coset i lies in it. Fix a coset i.
steps.lean:
refine ((h.prodMk h').tsum_eq ▸ tsum_mem (((proj V ∘ₗ proj s).prod (proj V' ∘ₗ proj s') ∘ₗ
    D.heckeAlgebra.val.toLinearMap).range.map ((a • Φ V).prodMap
    (a' • Φ V'))).closed_of_finiteDimensional fun i ↦ ?_).elim (by rintro _ ⟨⟨p, ⟨⟩⟩, ⟨⟩⟩; tauto)

steps.claim: Every form y in principalForms(D, V), for any space V, is fixed by right translation by every element of chosenLevel(D).
steps.lean: have f {s V} (y : @D.principalForms _ s V) := by simpa using (y.2 ·)

steps.claim: Let r = cosetRep(i), the component of the coset i above the places outside m-bar m (m = mModulus(D, theta, 1)).
Let H be the subgroup of chosenLevel(D) of the elements k with r^(-1) k r in chosenLevel(D).
H has finite index in chosenLevel(D): the conjugate of the open subgroup chosenLevel(D) is open, and an open subgroup of a compact group has finite index.

The pair of terms of i is the pair of p_i, where p_i is the scalar vacuumCoeff-factor / count / [chosenLevel : H] times the family of operators y -> sum over q in chosenLevel/H of R(q r q^(-1)) y on principal forms.
